Compute invasion fitness (λ) and optional establishment probability (P)

Source: R/predict_establishment.R
predict_establishment.Rd

Compute invasion fitness (λ) and optional establishment probability (P)

Usage

predict_establishment(
  fit,
  option = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"),
  calibrate_kappa = FALSE,
  prob_method = c(NULL, "probit", "logit", "hard"),
  prob_args = list(),
  method = NULL,
  prob_scale = NULL,
  boundary_sf = NULL,
  boundary_params = list(inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.3)
)

Arguments

fit

from predict_invaders().

option

character in c("A","B","C","D","E").

calibrate_kappa

logical; set κ so mean resident λ ≈ 0.

prob_method

(legacy) NULL or one of "probit","logit","hard".

prob_args

(legacy) list of args for compute_establishment_probability().

method

(alias) same as prob_method; preferred in user code.

prob_scale

(alias) same as prob_args; preferred in user code.

boundary_sf

An sf object to overlay as a boundary on map-like plots.

boundary_params

Named list of aesthetics for ggplot2::geom_sf; defaults to list(inherit.aes=FALSE, fill=NA, color="black", size=0.3).

Value

updated invasimapr_fit
